data.title: 26 U.S.C. §174 as it stood before 2022
data.summary: Under section 174(a)(1) as it stood before the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act took effect, a taxpayer could treat research or experimental expenditures paid or incurred in connection with a trade or business as expenses not chargeable to capital account, deductible in the year paid or incurred. Payroll spent on building product reduced taxable income in the same year it was spent.
data.citation: 26 U.S.C. §174, United States Code, 2017 Edition. U.S. Government Publishing Office.
